source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-8

procedures.title: Door lock striker: adjust
steps: The striker head should sit centered fore and aft (some tolerance is allowed), while keeping the minimum dimensions in figure 21 in the manual.
Use service spacers alone or stacked to reach the specified alignment.
To add spacers: pencil-mark the striker position on the lock pillar.
Fit a 5/16" wrench into the hex fitting in the striker bolt head and remove the striker (see figure 22 in the manual).
Reinstall in reverse order, keeping the striker inside the pencil mark.
notes: Important: after a door is removed/refitted or realigned, do not shut it fully until you have visually confirmed the fork-bolt engages the striker.
Figure 21 (striker impression minimum dimensions) is not on this page.

procedures.title: Door window: adjust
steps: In/out at the top of the window (do each channel): remove the door trim panel.
Loosen the 2 outer screws at the top of the inner door panel (View A, figure 23 in the manual).
Remove the hex nut on the adjusting stud (View B).
Turn the stud to place the window where wanted.
Retighten the hex nut and the 2 screws.
Up/down (screw-and-stop assemblies at upper and lower ends of each channel): loosen the 2 Phillips screws.
Slide the channel to the window height wanted.
Tighten the screws and recheck window position.
